stages.summary: Mathlib and formal-conjectures statements of the Riemann Hypothesis and Generalized Riemann Hypothesis, comparator challenges, and Main entry theorems.
stages.title: Formal Statements & Challenge Contracts

stages.summary: Auxiliary polynomial and Stepanov determinant construction at the foundation of the multiplicity method.
stages.title: Stepanov Determinant

stages.summary: Invariant derivation D with D^p = 0 on a CM curve for inert primes p and p-adic divisibility of theta derivatives.
stages.title: CM Curve Derivations and p-adic Divisibility

stages.summary: Writing qN = M^k + R via path quadrics and realizing automorphy of N through theta period integrals on the sixfold cover of GL_5.
stages.title: Quadric Decomposition and Sixfold-Cover Theta Automorphy

stages.summary: Establishing W(1_S) >= 0 through a determinant and reinterpreting it as a multiplicity-one Stepanov bootstrap.
stages.title: Positivity via Stepanov Determinant Bootstrap

stages.summary: Switching definitively to the von Mangoldt function Lambda with the Guinand-Weil sign and variance test-function trick.
stages.title: Von Mangoldt Switch and Guinand-Weil Variance Test Function

stages.summary: Applying W(1_(0,1] + (~X^eta) 1_(0,1/X]) >= 0 to drive the zero-free threshold beyond 1 - eta.
stages.title: Positivity Inequality for Zero-Free Width

stages.summary: Constructing determinants for W(.) carrying Gan-Gross-Prasad periods with interlacing and bounded non-interlacing weights.
stages.title: Determinants for GGP Periods and Interlacing Weights

stages.summary: Iterated theta lifts U(X_0) -> U(X_1) -> ... -> U(X_m) between totally definite unitary groups winning multiplicity m around sqrt(X).
stages.title: Iterated Unitary Theta Lifts

stages.summary: Norms and levels of iterated lifts and cancellation of order-m terms with divisibility via Chowla-Selberg, Weyl, and Siegel mass formulas.
stages.title: Norms, Levels, and Chowla-Selberg / Weyl / Siegel Mass Divisibility

stages.summary: Establishing a sufficient lower bound on the divisibility of the m-fold iterated theta lift.
stages.title: Lower Bound on Iterated Lift Divisibility

stages.summary: Constructing the Iwasawa tower by analogy to pigeonhole arguments over finite field extensions F_{q^n}/F_q.
stages.title: Iwasawa Tower Pigeonhole Analogy

stages.summary: Seesaw identity identifying the period of the iterated lift as a Bessel period independent of the Hecke characters via Rallis.
stages.title: Seesaw Identity and Rallis Bessel Period

stages.summary: Applying the Bost slope inequality from Arakelov geometry to bound arithmetic degrees.
stages.title: Bost Slope Inequality

stages.summary: Precise accounting of each lift's cost, overcoming the a priori 2/3 barrier through twisting and division.
stages.title: Lift Cost Accounting and Breaking the 2/3 Barrier

stages.summary: Gluing an integral structure across Hecke characters to achieve extra averaging and a greatest-common-divisor effect.
stages.title: Glued Integral Structure Across Hecke Characters

stages.summary: Relative trace formula via sixfold-cover GL_5 automorphy of mu, reducing by Cauchy-Schwarz to projected Poincare series norms and approximate column orthogonality.
stages.title: Relative Trace Formula and Poincare Series Orthogonality

stages.summary: Handling surviving classes in H^1(O_E[1/ell], Q_ell/Z_ell(-e)) not killed by twisting via a significant weakening of Vandiver.
stages.title: Cohomology Classes and Weakened Vandiver

stages.summary: Computing covolumes, theta series indices, and congruences between iterated lifts and automorphic forms.
stages.title: Covolumes, Theta Series Index, and Lift Congruences

stages.summary: Selecting the exact Iwasawa tower parameters using Behrend's construction.
stages.title: Precise Iwasawa Tower Choice via Behrend

stages.summary: Completing the proof of the Generalized Riemann Hypothesis and deducing the classical Riemann Hypothesis.
stages.title: Generalized Riemann Hypothesis (GRH)
